description: Preflight (robinhood-trading, unofficial) for Codex: the order guard and nothing else. It blocks MCP tools named place_*, exercise_* or replace_* on any server, and other money-moving verbs on a server whose name contains robinhood. It never returns an allow decision. Codex skips it until you review and trust it in /hooks. The Claude Code hooks in hooks/hooks.json (session line, cancel prompts, audit log, confirm mode) are deliberately not loaded in Codex.
